notice: This is a static informational document, not a booking, availability, quote, or checkout API.

offerings.name: AutoClarity iPhone app
offerings.summary: An iPhone symptom-guidance product that asks questions about a vehicle's symptoms and provides possible causes, urgency and safety information, repair-cost direction, recommended next steps, and a shareable report without requiring an OBD scanner.
offerings.bestFor: Drivers who want informational guidance about symptoms before speaking with a repair shop.

pricing.introductoryEligibility: Eligible new subscribers in the United States; Apple determines eligibility.
pricing.renewalQualification: Renews unless canceled. Customers who are not eligible for the introductory offer see Apple's applicable localized standard annual price before purchase.

limitations: It is informational guidance, not hands-on inspection, scan-tool testing, or diagnosis by a qualified automotive technician.
It does not include an in-person pre-purchase inspection.
Only the United States App Store listing was verified; Apple controls storefront availability, eligibility, and the price displayed to each customer.
offerings.nextStep: Open the verified App Store listing and review the price and eligibility Apple displays before purchasing.

offerings.name: AutoClarity Las Vegas mobile pre-purchase inspection
offerings.summary: A separate mobile, founder-performed pre-purchase vehicle inspection service for reviewed locations in the Las Vegas area.
offerings.bestFor: Used-car buyers seeking an in-person inspection in the listed Las Vegas-area service region before purchase.

startingPrices.name: Standard Vehicle PPI
startingPrices.qualification: Starting price; commonly applies to unmodified domestic, Japanese, and Korean passenger vehicles and light trucks.

startingPrices.name: European, Luxury or Performance PPI
startingPrices.qualification: Starting price; applies to European, luxury, performance, and other higher-complexity vehicles after review.

startingPrices.name: Exotic, Collector or Heavily Modified PPI
startingPrices.qualification: Starting price; final quote requires review of the exact vehicle, location, and scope.

pricing.qualification: Every final price requires review of the vehicle, location, access, and confirmed inspection scope.

serviceArea.qualification: Every location is subject to review.
serviceArea.distanceBasis: Distance from the central Las Vegas service area; the exact total is shown before payment.

limitations: A submitted request is not an appointment. AutoClarity reviews the vehicle, location, scope, and seller access before sending an exact quote and available times.
A booking is confirmed only after the required agreements are accepted and successful payment is recorded.
Inspection scope depends on the vehicle, location, access, permission, safety, and confirmed quote.
Road tests require seller permission and safe, lawful conditions.
A pre-purchase inspection is a professional opinion about observable condition, not a warranty, guarantee, or promise to identify every defect.
The service does not include repairs, and an app subscription does not include this physical inspection.
offerings.nextStep: Submit the inspection request form for review. Submitting is free and does not confirm an appointment or charge the customer.

relationship: The iPhone app and Las Vegas inspection are separate products. Buying the app subscription does not include a physical inspection, and the app is not required to request one.
